notes.title: Audio Update: Check your settings for Windows Sonic
notes.content:
We've updated our audio system! 

If you encounter any issues, please make sure that [url=https://www.windowscentral.com/how-use-windows-sonic-windows-10-creators-update/]Windows Sonic[/url] is enabled. Email us at support@plutovr.com if you have any questions or comments. 

[img]https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/plutovr/assets/Windows+Sonic.png[/img]

notes.title: Attend a Panel Chat on the 2018 VR User Survey - Wed., May 2 at 11 a.m. PST
notes.content:
[h1]Have you heard about the 2018 VR User Survey?[/h1]

In February of 2018, more than 600 regular VR users shared their thoughts on data privacy and how they experience the social side of VR. 

[b]Join us on Wednesday, May 2, at 11 a.m. PST [/b]

This open discussion will be held in VR using the Pluto communication service. Participate live by joining a Pluto conversation with SerahD during those times. 
Download the service [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/389980]HERE[/url] and email support@plutovr.com if you have any problems getting connected. 

We’ll also post a mixed reality video recording on YouTube after the discussion. For more info, visit the [url=https://www.plutovr.com/panel-chat-on-2018-vr-user-survey-results/]event web page[/url]. 

[url=https://www.plutovr.com/panel-chat-on-2018-vr-user-survey-results][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32139510/f5b91800402d5879f44b9ebeb71a370299b99d62.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Welcome to Pluto!
notes.content:
[b] Thanks for trying out Pluto, the communications service for people in VR. Our purpose is to help humanity transcend physical location.[/b]

What can you do on Pluto? Make yourself available! 
[list] 
[*]First, add people to your contacts list, like friends, family, and professional contacts. 

[*]Start Pluto when you open Steam. 

[*]Leave it on when you're in VR and available to connect. 

[*]Then you and your friends can use Pluto to call each other anytime you want to chat face-to-face, meet up, or have a shared experience [/list]

[b] Tell us what you think![/b]

As an early Pluto customer, please let us know as soon as you encounter bugs, have questions, or would like to give us feedback about your Pluto experience. We're relying on you to help us make the service better, so send us your thoughts as often as possible. 

You can talk with us in the Steam discussion forums, on our Discord site at tinyurl dot com plutodiscord, or email us directly at support@plutovr.com.
